Tenant switch: menu opens, search works, clicking [data-testid=hq-tenant-switch-miracurl-marathahalli] navigates straight to /dashboard (act-as, no confirm dialog) — acceptable per task. Mobile 390×844: sidebar hidden off-canvas by default (left=-280px), [data-testid=hq-sidebar-open] hamburger slides it to left=0, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390). WA Blast modal: opens from [data-testid=wa-blast-open-btn]; setup hint mentions '+919180379552'; Compose generated a queue (lead 1/20 Apple Unisex Salon · Pune), [data-testid=wa-blast-phone-check] present showing 'Mobile — WhatsApp likely · IN', meta mode shows meta-preview + send-meta-btn (NOT clicked per instructions), toggling to manual reveals wa-blast-message textarea + wa-blast-send-btn. History panel [data-testid=wa-outreach-history] renders below quick-invite with wa-history-filter-all|meta|manual. Mira Home readability spot-check: text nodes sampled on light cards use dark/medium colours (slate-500 rgb(100,116,139), gold rgb(243,223,174) on tinted dark-gold card, violet rgb(109,40,217) on violet-tint, etc.) over cream/white — no white-on-white detected. Overall: all requested checks for both (A) HQ redesign and (B) WA outreach upgrade work.

issues: The AI-mascot hero behind Mira Home still renders with its original dark cosmic background (purple/black) in the cream HQ layout — this is intentional per task spec (dark-native widget remapped light outside), but the mascot section itself is still visually dark; readable, just contrast island vs rest of cream page. Not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing React hydration warning in console when navigating sections: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' — happens inside SuperAdminProtected tree. Not caused by iter-219 code but should be cleaned up (an <option> contains a <span>).
Pre-existing CSP violation on inline script hash mismatch still present on /super-admin (same issue as iter-218 report) — not iter-219 related.

lead_wa_outreach.py: _template_body() cache check compares an ISO datetime string against an unmoored date — works only because midnight-ISO truncation makes it string-comparable; brittle. Suggest storing fetched_at as a date and comparing numerically.

Tenant switch skips the confirm dialog entirely and navigates straight to /dashboard — task said either is acceptable; still worth noting there's no 'super-admin acting as X' audit log confirmation step surfaced to the user before navigation.
